Oven Apple Butter
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, January 3, 2010 - 12:57am

Ingredients




8 Granny Smith apples peeled, diced
1 cup apple juice
1 cup sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon

Preparation

1 Cook diced apple and juice in a Dutch oven over medium heat 30 minutes or until apple is tender. Stir until apple is mashed. Stir in sugar and cinnamon. Pour apple mixture into a lightly greased 11- by 7-inch baking dish. 2 Bake at 275 degrees for 4 1/2 hours, stirring every hour, or until spreading consistency. Cover and chill. 3 For Spiced Oven Apple Butter: Increase cinnamon to 2 teaspoons and add 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves and 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice. 4 This recipe yields 3 cups. 5 Yield: 3 cups
